description: PROCEDURE: Full container pipeline in one step — auto-detects Podman or Docker, builds for linux/amd64, pushes to IBM Container Registry (ICR), creates or updates a Code Engine application, waits for ready, and returns the public URL. Accepts a project name or ID. Builds the full ICR image path from namespace + app name + tag so you do not need to know ICR URLs. When PROVENANCE_ENABLED=true, emits signed receipts for Dockerfile validation and deploy completion (fail-open).

app_name.description: Name for the application in Code Engine (e.g. my-app)

context_path.description: Path to the directory containing the Dockerfile (e.g. examples/starwars-splash or ./my-app)

dry_run.description: When true, validate inputs and the Dockerfile and return the planned image reference and steps WITHOUT building, pushing, or deploying. Use to preview a deployment safely.

env_vars.description: Key/value environment variables to set on the app

icr_host.description: ICR host (default: us.icr.io — leave blank unless using a different region)

icr_namespace.description: Your IBM Container Registry namespace (e.g. my-namespace). Use icr_list_namespaces to find it.

image_secret.description: Name of the registry pull secret in Code Engine (e.g. icr-pull-secret). Created with ce_create_secret format=registry.

image_tag.description: Image version tag (e.g. v1.0.0 or latest). Defaults to "latest".

port.description: Container port the app listens on (default 8080)

project_id_or_name.description: Code Engine project name (e.g. "my-project") or project ID (UUID). Use ce_list_projects if unsure.

scale_min_instances.description: Minimum running instances (default 0 = scale to zero)

timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for app ready (default 180)

name: proc_build_push_deploy
